name: Water Vole
idea: Temperate water mammal: the bank vole that plops into the river (Evasive) and swims (Tide).
flavor: Plop! Gone under the bank before the heron has even turned its head.

name: River Mink
idea: Temperate water mammal: a small fierce mustelid that swims (Tide) and lunges at what it sees (Pounce 2). Not an Otter-faction card.
flavor: Swims like an otter, bites like a stoat, and answers to neither.

name: Signal Crayfish
idea: The invasive river crayfish with white claw patches: a shell (Armor 1) and pinching claws (Crab Claws).
flavor: It waves its white-flagged claws at everything, which is not the same as surrendering.

name: Pine Marten
idea: The squirrel hunter that runs down trunks: Quick, Pounce 2.
flavor: Down the trunk headfirst, and the squirrel never hears it coming.

name: Woodcock Lookout
idea: All-round eyes, out at dusk: Crepuscular 1 and Keen Eye.
flavor: Eyes on the sides of its head, and out only at dusk, when the light lies.

name: Grass Snake
idea: Britain's swimming snake that plays dead: Tide, and Revive (the first time it dies it comes back with 1 Health).
flavor: Corner it and it rolls over, tongue out, and plays dead. Very convincingly.

name: Ladybird Guard
idea: Warning colours that protect the row: Guardian.
flavor: Seven spots, one bad taste, and a promise that you will only bite once.

name: Hedgerow Shrew
idea: Always in a hurry: Quick.
flavor: It must eat every few hours or starve, so it is always, always in a hurry.

name: Stag Beetle
idea: Antler jaws for wrestling: Armor 1, Cleave (Sweep) 1.
flavor: All that jaw is for wrestling rivals. Your little units will do.

name: Slow-worm
idea: The legless lizard that drops its tail: Revive (comes back once with 1 Health).
flavor: Not a worm, not slow, and not finished just because you grabbed its tail.

name: Robin Redbreast
idea: The fierce garden robin: Flying, Diurnal.
flavor: The friendliest bird in the garden, until another robin lands on its patch.

name: Field Vole
idea: Never just one: Swarm.
flavor: There is never just one field vole. By autumn there are hundreds.

name: Pincushion Urchin
idea: Owner's example ("pin cushions (uni = sea urchins)"): a spiny rock-pool urchin, Thorns 2 and Tide. No urchin emoji exists: the spiky chestnut 🌰 stands in.
flavor: The rock pool's pin cushion. Step on it once and you will always know where it lives.

name: Rock Pool Starfish
idea: Regrows its arms: Regen 2, Tide.
flavor: Pull off an arm and it simply grows another. It has five to spare.

name: Oystercatcher
idea: The shell-opening bill: Flying, Pierce 2 (ignores 2 Armor).
flavor: A bill like an orange chisel, made for opening what wants to stay shut.

name: Sanderling
idea: Runs with the waves: Tide, Evasive.
flavor: Chases the wave out, flees it back in, all day long, on clockwork legs.

name: Grey Seal Bull
idea: Temperate water mammal: the big bull guarding his pups on the shingle: Tide, Guardian.
flavor: Hauls out on the shingle every autumn and lets nothing near his pups.

name: Limpet Clinger
idea: Clamps down: Shell 2, Tide.
flavor: When the tide goes out it clamps down. Nothing short of a chisel shifts it.

name: Puffin Diver
idea: The sea parrot (🦜) that flies and dives: Flying, Tide.
flavor: Ten sand eels in its beak, and always room for one more.

name: Razorbill
idea: A bill like a razor: Flying, Bleed 1.
flavor: Its name is a warning about the bill, not the beard.

name: Kittiwake Flock
idea: A colony of gulls: Flying, Swarm.
flavor: Kitti-waaake! A thousand ledges, a thousand nests, one deafening chorus.

name: Peregrine Stooper
idea: The fastest dive alive: Flying, Quick, Pounce 2.
flavor: The fastest thing alive, falling on purpose.

name: Fulmar Spitter
idea: Spits stinking oil at anything that comes close: Flying, Thorns 2.
flavor: Get too close to its nest and it spits stinking oil all over your feathers.

name: Red-billed Chough
idea: The cliff-tumbling crow: Flying, Mountain Climber.
flavor: A crow in red stockings, tumbling off the cliff for the fun of it.

name: Muskrat Lodgekeeper
idea: Temperate water mammal: the reed lodge (Bulwark 1: your bramble takes 1 less per hit), Tide.
flavor: Its reed lodge rises from the flood like a haystack with its front door underwater.

name: Water Shrew
idea: Temperate water mammal with a venomous bite: Tide, Venomous 1.
flavor: Silver with bubbles as it dives, and its bite carries venom.

name: Pyrenean Desman
idea: Temperate water mammal: the near-blind trunked swimmer that hunts by touch: Tide, Keen Sense.
flavor: A trunked, near-blind swimmer that finds its supper by the touch of its whiskers.

name: Great Crested Grebe
idea: Sinks instead of flying: Tide, Evasive.
flavor: When trouble comes it does not fly. It sinks, and surfaces somewhere else.

name: Old Sturgeon
idea: Armoured plates, ancient and slow: Armor 2, Tide, Wait 3.
flavor: Older than the castle, armoured like a knight, and in no hurry at all.

name: Diving Bell Spider
idea: Waits in its underwater silk bell: Tide, Ambush 2.
flavor: It lives underwater in a bubble of silk and air, and waits there for you.

name: Alligator Gar
idea: Armoured scales and a gator's teeth: Tide, Armor 1, Bleed 1.
flavor: Half fish, half alligator, all teeth, and a hundred million years of practice.

name: Swamp Rabbit
idea: The rabbit that dives to escape: Tide, Evasive.
flavor: The only rabbit that dives in to escape the hounds. It has never met a gator.

name: Mosquito Cloud
idea: A blood tax: Flying, Bleed 1.
flavor: One is a nuisance. The whole cloud is a blood tax.

name: Fire Ant Raft
idea: The floating colony that stings: Tide, Poison 1, Swarm.
flavor: When the flood comes they link legs and float: a living raft that stings.

name: Anhinga Spearbird
idea: The snakebird that swims and spears: Tide, Pounce 2.
flavor: Swims with only its neck above water, then spears whatever swims past.

name: Roseate Spoonbill
idea: Sweeps its spoon side to side: Flying, Cleave (Sweep) 1.
flavor: Sweeps its spoon side to side through the mud and eats whatever it bumps.

name: Booming Bittern
idea: Hides frozen in the reeds (Invisible 2) and booms (Daunt 1).
flavor: Freezes among the reeds by day. At night it booms like a drum underwater.

name: Giant Water Bug
idea: The toe-biter: Tide, Venomous 2.
flavor: The toe-biter. It waits on the bottom with its arms wide open.

name: Water Scorpion
idea: Snorkel tail, grabs what swims by: Tide, Sentry.
flavor: Breathes through its tail like a snorkel and grabs whatever swims by.

name: Greater Siren
idea: The eel-like salamander that waits out droughts in mud: Tide, Regen 3.
flavor: When the swamp dries it seals itself in mud and waits, for years if it must.

name: Marsh Harrier
idea: Quarters low and drops on the small: Flying, Predator 1.
flavor: Quarters low over the reeds, wings in a V, and drops on anything that squeaks.

name: Raft Spider
idea: Feels for ripples in the dark: Tide, Darksight.
flavor: Rests its feet on the water and feels for ripples in the dark.

name: Leopard Slug
idea: Slow, spotted, out at night: Regen 1, Nocturnal.
flavor: Spotted like a big cat, slow as a slug, and very fond of mushrooms.

name: Wolf Spider Mother
idea: Carries her spiderlings and runs prey down: Brood 2, Pounce 2.
flavor: She carries her spiderlings on her back, and still runs you down.

name: Truffle Piglet
idea: Finds treasure: On Ready, +1 Lumber.
flavor: Nose to the leaf litter, it finds the treasure you were standing on.

name: Fungus Gnat Cloud
idea: A haze from the gills: Flying, Swarm.
flavor: Born in the gills, they rise in a haze wherever a mushroom is cut.

name: Springtail Hopper
idea: The spring-loaded speck: Evasive, Quick.
flavor: Smaller than a seed, with a spring folded under its belly. Blink and it is gone.

name: Red-backed Salamander
idea: The lungless log-dweller: Regen 2.
flavor: Breathes through its damp skin and lives under the same log for years.

name: Cave Cricket
idea: All legs and listening: Darksight, Evasive.
flavor: Legs twice as long as its body, and every one of them listening.

name: Ghost Crayfish
idea: The pale, blind, century-old cave crayfish: Darksight, Armor 1, Regen 1.
flavor: Pale as candle wax, blind as a stone, and it lives a hundred years in the dark.

name: Cave Swiftlet
idea: Echolocates by clicks: Flying, Sonar.
flavor: Clicks its way through the pitch dark, and builds its nest from its own spit.

name: Cave Pseudoscorpion
idea: Venom-tipped claws: Darksight, Poison 1.
flavor: A scorpion with no tail and no sting, just two venom-tipped claws the size of grains.

name: Whip Spider
idea: Feels the dark with its whip legs, strikes with spiny arms: Sonar, Bleed 1.
flavor: It feels the dark with two whip-long legs, then strikes with the spiny pair.

name: Giant Cave Huntsman
idea: Owner request (23:32: "We don't have a really scary spider. Not trapdoor or cute."): a huge hairy hunting spider, part Goliath birdeater, part huntsman, part funnel-web. It sees in the dark (Darksight), rushes the first thing it sees (Pounce 3), its bite is venom (Poison 2) and it is terrifying (Daunt 1: its hits lower the target's Attack).
art: NightCafe prompt: "A huge hairy hunting spider the size of a dinner plate, crouched on wet black cave rock, long thick banded legs, dense bristling brown hair, eight glossy black eyes catching a faint light, deep limestone cave background with dripping stalactites and a thin blue glow from a crack above, dark eerie atmosphere, detailed pixel art, full background"
flavor: Wider than your face, faster than your scream, and it has already seen you.

name: Guano Beetle
idea: Lives on what falls from the roost: Darksight, Carrion 2.
flavor: Under every bat roost there is a heap, and under every heap, a thousand of these.

name: Banded Sea Krait
idea: Owner's example (sea snakes): hunts eels by night in the roots: Tide (the Swimmer), Venomous 2, Nocturnal.
flavor: Hunts eels in the roots by night, then crawls ashore to lay its eggs.

name: Fishing Cat
idea: The cat that dives for fish: Tide, Pounce 2.
flavor: A cat that loves the water: it taps the surface like a lure, then dives.

name: Proboscis Monkey
idea: Everyone looks at that nose: Tide, Taunt.
flavor: That nose honks across the whole mangrove. Everyone looks. That is the point.

name: Horseshoe Crab
idea: Not a crab: a living fossil, closer kin to spiders: Armor 2, Tide.
flavor: Not a crab at all, but older than the dinosaurs, with blue blood to prove it.

name: Sea Hare
idea: Hides in a cloud of ink: Tide, Smoke Bomb.
flavor: A sea slug with rabbit ears that hides behind a cloud of purple ink.

name: Mangrove Manatee
idea: Half a tonne of patience (no manatee emoji: the seal stands in): Tide, Regen 2, Guardian.
flavor: Half a tonne of seagrass and patience, drifting through the roots at walking pace.

name: Yellow-bellied Sea Snake
idea: Owner's example (sea snakes): the open-ocean drifter: Tide (the Swimmer), Poison 3.
flavor: It drifts with the slicks in the open ocean and never comes ashore at all.

name: Crown-of-thorns Star
idea: The venom-spined reef eater: Thorns 2, Poison 1, Tide.
flavor: It eats the reef from the top down, and every one of its spines is venomous.

name: Parrotfish
idea: Bites coral to sand: Tide, Pierce 1.
flavor: It bites the coral to bits, and every white beach began in its gut.

name: Lionfish
idea: Every fin a venomous spine: Tide, Thorns 2.
flavor: Its fins spread like a fan of feathers. Every feather is a venomous spine.

name: Giant Clam
idea: Closes like a door and farms algae: Shell 2, Regen 1, Tide.
flavor: It farms algae in its own lips, and closes like a door.

name: Great Barracuda
idea: The silver blade: Tide, Quick.
flavor: It hangs in the current like a silver blade. Then it is not there any more.

name: Whale Shark
idea: The biggest fish: Tide, Armor 1, Scare 1.
flavor: The biggest fish in the sea lives on the smallest things in it.

name: Chamois Leaper
idea: Ledge to ledge: Mountain Climber, Pounce 2.
flavor: Leaps from ledge to ledge where even the ibex think twice.

name: Alpine Swift
idea: Lives on the wing: Flying, Quick.
flavor: It eats, drinks and sleeps on the wing, and may not land for half a year.

name: Wallcreeper
idea: A grey speck on the rock: Mountain Climber, Invisible 1.
flavor: A grey mouse of a bird on the cliff face, until it opens its crimson wings.

name: Alpine Salamander
idea: Black and hard to impress: Regen 1, Scare 1.
flavor: Jet black, born live after two years inside its mother, and very hard to impress.

name: Apollo Butterfly
idea: Warning eyespots, bad to eat: Flying, Thorns 1.
flavor: Red eyespots on white wings: a warning the thin mountain air carries a long way.

name: Mountain Hare
idea: Turns white for winter: Evasive, Frostbite 1.
flavor: Brown in summer, white in winter, and always one leap ahead of the eagle.

name: Thorn Shrike
idea: The butcher bird that impales its prey on thorns: Flying, Bleed 2.
flavor: The butcher bird: it keeps a larder of beetles and mice, hung up on the thorns.

name: Hedge Weasel
idea: Follows the mouse into its hole: Predator 2.
flavor: Thin enough to follow a mouse down its own hole, and it does.

name: Hawthorn Shieldbug
idea: A green shield and a stink: Armor 1, Daunt 1.
flavor: A green shield with red trim, and a smell that clears the hedge.

name: Muntjac Barker
idea: The barking deer: Sentry.
flavor: A deer no bigger than a dog, and it barks like one at anything in the hedge.

name: Anvil Thrush
idea: Smashes snail shells on its stone: Flying, Pierce 2.
flavor: It sings the hedge awake each dawn, then smashes snails on its favourite stone.

name: Garden Tiger Moth
idea: The woolly bear's bristles and the moth's bad taste: Flying, Nocturnal, Thorns 1.
flavor: Its woolly-bear caterpillar is all bristles, and the moth tastes even worse.

name: Polar Bear
idea: Waits at the seal's breathing hole: Ambush 4 (hits whatever enters the slot facing it), Tide.
flavor: It waits at the breathing hole for hours. The seal only has to come up once.

name: Harp Seal Pup
idea: Grows fast on rich milk: Tide, Molting 1 (+1/+1 every 2 rounds).
flavor: A white bundle on the pack ice, drinking the richest milk in the sea.

name: Beluga
idea: The singing sea canary: Tide, Sonar, Inspiring 1.
flavor: The sea canary: it whistles and chirps under the ice, and the pod sings back.

name: Arctic Tern
idea: Pole to pole, the most daylight of any animal: Flying, Diurnal.
flavor: Pole to pole and back every year: it sees more daylight than anything alive.

name: Lemming Swarm
idea: Millions in a boom year: Swarm, Brood 1.
flavor: Every few years there are millions, and every owl in the tundra eats well.

name: Krill Swarm
idea: Feeds the cold sea: Tide, Swarm.
flavor: Each one is nothing. Together they feed the whole cold sea.

name: Greenland Shark
idea: Four hundred years under the ice, a scavenger: Tide, Carrion 2, Armor 1.
flavor: Four hundred years old, slow as the ice, and it has never once hurried.

name: Ringed Seal
idea: The polar bear's seal, hidden in its snow lair: Tide, Invisible 2.
flavor: It scratches a breathing hole through the ice with its claws, and keeps it open all winter.

name: Woodland Caribou
idea: Snowshoe hooves and a herd that never stops: Mountain Climber, Frostbite 1.
flavor: Wide hooves for snow, a nose for lichen, and a herd that never stops walking.

name: Musk Ox Calf
idea: In the middle of the ring: Armor 1, Frostbite 1.
flavor: When the wolves come, the herd forms a ring, and the calves go in the middle.
